sentences.text:
16.02.2024 Heard Mr. S.C. Biswas, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms. M. Das, learned Standing Counsel, Public Works Department [PWD] for the respondent nos. 1 & 6; Ms. G. Hazarika,
learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department for the respondent no. 2; and Ms. M. Barman,
learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 3, 4 & 5.
2.

The case of the petitioners is that their Patta lands are sought to be acquired under 'the Land Acquisition through Direct Purchase by way of Negotiated Settlement' Scheme', notified by a Notification dated 20.01.2021 [Annexure-1].
According to the petitioners, the State respondents are offering Rs. 3,06,000/- per Bigha in respect of the petitioners' patta Page No.# 5/5 lands.
The petitioners have claimed that the market value of the petitioners' lands is Rs. 10,50,000/- per Bigha.
As per the direct purchase by way of negotiated settlement method, the land acquisition process can be proceeded with only if the owners of the land agree to sale the land at the price offered.

As per the scheme, in the event any of the owners refuses to sale the land or any of the owners has objected or not interested with the direct purchase through negotiation, the respective land can be acquired through the acquisition process of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Rules, 2015, framed under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.

4 3. The learned counsel for the respondents have submitted that they are yet to receive instructions as to whether there is possibility of any negotiated settlement in respect of the petitioners' patta lands.

4. Issue notice, returnable on 18.03.2024.
5.
As all the respondents have appeared and accepted notices through the learned counsel, no formal notice need to be issued to the respondents.

The learned counsel for the petitioners shall furnish requisite nos. of extra copies of the writ petition along with the annexures, to the learned counsel for the respondents within 3 [three] working days from today.
6. List the case on 18.03.2024.
